windswept-hills.name: Windswept Hills
windswept-hills.subtitle: Starting region field pack
windswept-hills.summary: A practical opening-area guide for the Plateau of Beginnings and the surrounding hills. Use it to route early fast travel, prepare for the first Alpha encounters, and keep starter resources close.

fastTravel.name: Plateau of Beginnings
fastTravel.note: Primary starting point and the cleanest reset point for early gathering loops.

fastTravel.name: Grassy Behemoth Hills
fastTravel.note: Useful access point for Mammorest and nearby starter-resource routes.

fastTravel.name: Ravine Entrance
fastTravel.note: A western route into wider exploration and nearby cave searches.

bosses.name: Chillet
bosses.note: A strong first Alpha goal once you have better spheres, armor, and a reliable combat Pal.

bosses.name: Mammorest
bosses.note: Visible early but intended for much later. Mark it now; do not treat proximity as readiness.

resources.name: Wood and Stone
resources.note: Gather around the Plateau of Beginnings while unlocking the first technology tiers.

resources.name: Red Berries
resources.note: Keep a small food reserve before pushing away from the starting plateau.

resources.name: Pal Fluids
resources.note: Useful for early production structures; pair the search with nearby capture goals.

resources.name: Ore
resources.note: Flag promising nodes for a future mining base instead of carrying every stack home.
